suggestion.title: New item icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the Two Tails armor set.

New icon: a black-lacquer chest guard with crimson cloth, claw-point pauldrons, claw-slash markings and a gold nekomata emblem. Matches the Kitsune set's style with an offensive two-tailed cat theme; replaces the old icon.
New icon: a black hood with cat-ear points and a fanged nekomata half-mask, in the set's black, crimson and gold. Part of the new Two Tails icon set matching the Kitsune set's style.
New icon: a black-lacquer gauntlet with gold claw tips and a gold nekomata emblem at the wrist. Part of the new Two Tails icon set matching the Kitsune set's style.
New icon: crimson leg guards with black-lacquer greaves, gold knee caps and twin crimson streamers like two tails. Part of the new Two Tails icon set matching the Kitsune set's style.
New icon: black-lacquer split-toe boots with crimson wraps and gold claw-point toe caps. Part of the new Two Tails icon set matching the Kitsune set's style.
